exposure: Time from delivery of placenta to return to recovery room
Time from delivery of the fetus until the end of the operation
cohort: 953 women who underwent vaginal delivery (n=560) or cesarean section (n=393) at a tertiary medical center between January and December 2018
finding: PPH was significantly underestimated in vaginal deliveries, and a hemoglobin-based blood loss of 500 ml and 1000 ml may be useful as early warning and diagnostic cut-off values, respectively.
mod_finding: PPH incidence and risk factors differed between vaginal deliveries and cesarean sections, highlighting the need for distinct approaches to PPH prevention and management.
